name: kocax-buddy-workplace-v1-handoff
description: Personal-only Buddy Workplace reference implementation and audited handoff pack.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @kocax/buddy-contracts && npm run build -w @kocax/buddy-api && npm run build -w @kocax/buddy-workplace
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @kocax/buddy-workplace
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @kocax/buddy-api
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @kocax/buddy-contracts && npm run test -w @kocax/buddy-api && npm run test -w @kocax/buddy-workplace
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @kocax/buddy-contracts && npm run typecheck -w @kocax/buddy-api && npm run typecheck -w @kocax/buddy-workplace
scripts.verify: npm run audit:static && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run smoke:built-api
